Name: CS_GRAPHICS_CONFIG_PARAM_ST
Description: Graphics quality presets, one level per option (1 lowest – 4 highest). Appears unused by the game: the PC Low/Medium/High/Maximum presets are built in. Retail rows 0–8 differ mainly in texture filtering and ray tracing, and may be per-platform defaults.

Fields.Name: Texture Filter Quality
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: 2 on rows 0, 2, 3, 5, 7; 3 on rows 1, 6, 8; 1 on row 4.

Fields.Name: AA Quality
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: 3 on all rows.

Fields.Name: SSAO Quality
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: 3, except 1 on row 4.

Fields.Name: Depth of Field Quality
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: 3, except 1 on row 4.

Fields.Name: Motion Blur Quality
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: 3, except 2 on row 4.

Fields.Name: Shadow Quality
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: 3; 4 on rows 6 and 8; 2 on row 4.

Fields.Name: Lighting Quality
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: 3, except 2 on row 4.

Fields.Name: Effect Quality
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: 3, except 2 on row 4.

Fields.Name: Decal Quality
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: 3, except 2 on row 4.

Fields.Name: Reflection Quality
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: 3; 4 on rows 6 and 8; 1 on row 4.

Fields.Name: Water Quality
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: 3, except 2 on row 4.

Fields.Name: Shader Quality
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: 3, except 2 on row 4.

Fields.Name: Volumetric Effect Quality
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: 3; 4 on rows 6 and 8; 1 on row 4.

Fields.Name: Raytracing Quality
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: 3 on rows 0 and 1; 2 on rows 6 and 8; 0 on the rest (0 is outside the 1–4 quality levels).
